title: Uniview Technologies
description:
Overview

Country: China | Website: uniview.com | Revenue: $610 Million | Industry: Manufacturing, Electronics | Employees: 1000-5000 Employees | Properties: 1.5 TB (2,172,194 Files, 114,352 Folders)
Detailed Analysis

We have 1.5 TB of the company’s confidential data. We have all the company’s passwords and those of its employees from all devices, and we have a complete set of documents for all employees (approximately 10,000 employees), including their passport information and all additional documents! We have access to all employees’ personal social media accounts as well as the company’s IT infrastructure. We also have all the company’s databases, all financial transactions, and all invoices. There are many confidential contracts and even top-secret agreements between the company and other countries and companies. We have photos and videos showing that the company’s cameras are used in places such as prisons, hospitals, cities, and many private projects—we have all this data. We’ll attach a lot of other interesting material later... Thank you for your attention!

Uniview Technologies Co Ltd is the third-largest video surveillance manufacturer in China and fourth-largest globally, having achieved approximately 13-fold revenue growth since its founding in 2011. Differentiated by its core networking expertise, Uniview approaches the CCTV and video surveillance market with a technology-forward strategy that sets it apart from traditional competitors. The company prioritizes continuous research and development to maintain competitive advantage in a market where technological capabilities are superseded every three years, enabling Uniview to deliver professional, reliable, and cutting-edge surveillance products and services designed to build safer communities worldwide. With operations spanning 145 countries and regions, Uniview has established 12 international subsidiaries and branch offices to provide timely sales and localized support, with plans for continued geographic expansion. The company operates a Tongxiang Manufacturing Base in China
